title: Glowing tractor
svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 100 100">
  <!-- Ground glow -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="82" rx="42" ry="8" fill="#1a3a1a" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="62" y="28" width="5" height="16" rx="1.5" fill="#8a6d3b"/>
  <rect x="60" y="25" width="9" height="5" rx="2" fill="#a08050"/>

  <!-- Engine hood -->
  <rect x="42" y="38" width="32" height="22" rx="3" fill="#e85020"/>
  <rect x="42" y="38" width="32" height="6" rx="3" fill="#ff6a30"/>
  <!-- Hood highlight -->
  <rect x="48" y="44" width="20" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#ffaa70" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Cab body -->
  <rect x="14" y="30" width="30" height="30" rx="4" fill="#d04010"/>
  <rect x="14" y="30" width="30" height="8" rx="4" fill="#ff6a30"/>
  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x="18" y="34" width="22" height="14" rx="3" fill="#40c8ff"/>
  <rect x="18" y="34" width="22" height="5" rx="3" fill="#80e0ff" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Cab light -->
  <rect x="38" y="50" width="5" height="4" rx="1" fill="#ffe080"/>

  <!-- Big rear wheel -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="18" fill="#2a1a10"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="14" fill="#3a2a18"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="14" fill="none" stroke="#ff9020" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="7" fill="#c08020"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="72" r="3" fill="#ffcc50"/>
  <!-- Wheel spokes -->
  <line x1="30" y1="58" x2="30" y2="86" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="16" y1="72" x2="44" y2="72" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="62" x2="40" y2="82" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="62" x2="20" y2="82" stroke="#ffaa40" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- Small front wheel -->
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="10" fill="#2a1a10"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="7.5" fill="#3a2a18"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="7.5" fill="none" stroke="#ff9020" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="4" fill="#c08020"/>
  <circle cx="68" cy="76" r="1.8" fill="#ffcc50"/>

  <!-- Axle connecting wheels -->
  <rect x="42" y="68" width="22" height="5" rx="2" fill="#8a6d3b"/>

  <!-- Front grill -->
  <rect x="73" y="44" width="6" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#a08050"/>
  <line x1="75" y1="46" x2="75" y2="56" stroke="#d0b070" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="78" y1="46" x2="78" y2="56" stroke="#d0b070" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="76" cy="42" r="4" fill="#ffe060"/>
  <circle cx="76" cy="42" r="2" fill="#ffffb0"/>
  <!-- Headlight glow beam -->
  <polygon points="80,40 95,32 95,48 80,44" fill="#ffe060" opacity="0.25"/>

  <!-- Steering wheel -->
  <line x1="26" y1="30" x2="22" y2="22" stroke="#c08020" stroke-width="2.5"/>
  <circle cx="21" cy="20" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc50" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d="M12,72 Q12,52 30,52 Q48,52 48,72" fill="none" stroke="#ff6a30" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Decorative glow stripes on hood -->
  <rect x="46" y="54" width="24" height="2" rx="1" fill="#70e0ff" opacity="0.7"/>
</svg>
